Senior Business Analyst

Product Development Job Roles Responsibilities

  1. Be the Operational Truth Source for the Platform. You will be accountable for validating that platform outputs make sense in the real world. This includes:
  • Reviewing payer contracts, amendments, and fee schedules
  • Interpreting real-world contract logic (lesser-of, modifiers, MCO products, effective dates)
  • Reading raw 835 remits and identifying: Reimbursement issues vs legitimate adjustments; Payer miss configuration vs provider error; Systemic vs one-off issues
  • Calling out false positives and explaining why something is not a true issue. If something looks technically correct but operationally wrong, you are expected to stop it.
  1. Own Synthetic Data Realism (Critical). The platform will initially rely on synthetic data for development and validation. You will:
  • Define what realistic synthetic data looks like: payer mix, CARC/RARC distributions, modifier usage patterns, underpayment frequency and dollar impact
  • Review synthetic data sets and flag unrealistic assumptions
  • Guide engineers and vendors on correcting synthetic data generation logic. This role protects the credibility of everything we build.
  1. Be Deeply Embedded in Testing Validation. You will be hands-on in:
  • Reviewing detection outputs and classifying true vs false positives
  • Validating confidence scores against operational reality
  • Helping define suggested next step classifications (appeal, rebill, review, do not pursue)
  • Testing against real customer data during pilot phases. Your feedback will directly shape detection logic, confidence thresholds, and future AI agent behavior. You are effectively the human-in-the-loop backbone of the system.
  1. Act as the RCM Counterweight in Vendor Engagements. You will actively participate in vendor evaluations, technical reviews, and edge-case discussions. You will:
  • Ask uncomfortable but necessary questions
  • Spot hand-wavy answers around contracts or EDI
  • Distinguish between can build, has built, and is guessing
  • This role is critical to holding vendors accountable and ensuring delivery meets operational standards.
  1. Help Carry the Long-Term Platform Vision Forward. While the MVP starts with underpayments, the platform is designed to evolve toward:
  • Broader reimbursement correctness (denials, old AR, charge capture)
  • Recommendation intelligence and outcome monitoring
  • Selective automation with AI agents
  • Contract renegotiation insights. You will help ensure core data models are reusable, intelligence is generalized, and we t hard-code short term assumptions that block long-term evolution.

Candidate Requirements

Experience Domain Expertise

  • 6-10+ years in health care RCM revenue integrity, payer contracts, payment analysis, denials, or A/R
  • Experience working with ambiguous or conflicting data
  • Deep knowledge of payer contracts and fee schedules percent of Medicare, lesser-of, MCO products, modifier rules, effective dates
  • Deep knowledge of the RCM data ecosystem claims, remittances, fee schedules, industry benchmarks, regulatory references, and how they connect
  • Deep expertise in at least one RCM process area (appeals, denials, A/R follow-up, payment posting) you ll help design how AI agents execute these work flows

Judgment Mindset

  • Strong judgment in gray areas where contracts, data, and payer behavior don t line up
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions including those from engineers and vendors
  • Comfortable saying this would never happen in production
  • Builder mentality: you like shaping systems, not just running reports
  • Technical Comfort (Not a Data Scientist)

Technical Comfort (Not a Data Scientist)

  • SQL proficiency ability to query data, validate outputs, build test cases
  • Advanced Excel pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, large data set manipulation
  • Comfortable working with raw data (CSV, JSON, EDI extracts)
  • Able to explain domain logic clearly to engineers you t need to code, but you must understand how logic translates into systems

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with lab billing (CLFS) or physician billing (PFS) ideally both
  • Background in underpayment recovery, contract audits, or payer disputes
  • Familiarity with Medicare fee schedules and locality adjustments (GPCI)
  • Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery)
  • Prior experience in a startup or product development environment

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: Pune IN

Role - Senior AI Engineer About the Role
GHX is building an LLM-powered document understanding platform classification, structured data extraction, and intelligent orchestration at scale. This is a broad AI engineering role where you will own the full lifecycle from problem framing through to production quality.
You will start where the highest leverage is: designing prompts that behave like specifications and building the evaluation infrastructure that tells us whether the system actually works. Over time, the scope expands into agent orchestration, system architecture, and the migration of our existing rule-based pipeline to LLM-based equivalents.
Solid software engineering experience is a pre-requisite. You will design and build production services, own architectural decisions, and write code that others maintain. AI fluency amplifies good engineering it does not replace it.
This role requires 8+ years of software engineering experience as a foundation. The expectation is that you bring the same rigor to system design and code quality as you do to the prompt design and model evaluation. You know what should happen before evaluating what did happen and the discipline to close that gap rigorously.
How the Role Evolves
Now
Prompt engineering LLM evaluation
Design classification and extraction prompts, build ground truth datasets, create evaluation pipelines, and establish the quality baseline the team will build on.
6 12 mo
Agent orchestration pipeline design
Extend into multi-agent document processing pipelines, MCP-based tool integration, and orchestration of parallel AI workstreams.
12 mo+
Platform architecture migration ownership
Own the architecture of the document intelligence layer, lead the migration from rule-based systems, and define engineering standards for the team.
Core Responsibilities Prompt Engineering
  • Design classification and extraction prompts for diverse document types
  • Write prompts that function as formal specifications unambiguous and edge-case-aware
  • Build and iterate few-shot, chain-of-thought, and structured output templates
  • Own the prompt library, versioning, and rollback strategy
LLM Output Evaluation
  • Define and curate ground truth datasets for classification and extraction tasks
  • Build automated evaluation pipelines tracking precision, recall, and field-level accuracy
  • Validate outputs against intent catch what is technically correct but conceptually wrong
AI Agent Orchestration
  • Design multi-agent pipelines for document processing workflows
  • Integrate MCP servers and tool-use patterns for external service access
Software Engineering
  • Build production-grade APIs and services around LLM capabilities
  • Apply Clean Architecture or equivalent design for testability and maintainability
  • Write well-structured Python; own technical debt decisions consciously
  • Contribute to CI/CD, observability, and deployment pipelines
Stakeholder Interface
  • Serve as technical contact between business teams and the AI engineering layer
  • Communicate system constraints in product language; translate product needs into system boundaries
  • Surface quality metrics and model behaviour to non-technical stakeholders

  • AI agent orchestration
  • Clean Architecture / DDD

descriptionFromApi:
About Enterpret

As the world moves to AI native applications, one element matters more than anything: the data. At Enterpret, we are unlocking the most impactful dataset for businesses, customer feedback. We centralize feedback across every source, like Twitter, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Intercom, community forums, surveys, and Gong calls, into a single context graph. On top of it we build an adaptive taxonomy for each customer and an agent platform that lets teams query, monitor, and act on customer intelligence wherever they work, whether thats inside Enterpret, in Slack, or in their own AI tools through our MCP server.

Our customers include companies like Canva, Notion, WisprFlow, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, Western Union, and several other Product Led Growth decacorns and F500 companies. We are backed by Kleiner Perkins, Peak XV Partners, and Unusual Ventures.

Our engineering culture is AI-native from the ground up. Agents, LLMs, and applied ML are not a side project here, they are the core of how we build. We work at the edge of what is possible in agentic systems and push past it.

About the Role

Every record in Enterprets context graph arrives through an integration. We ingest customer context from fifty plus sources, and from our customers own systems through our ingestion API.

This surface decides how accurate, complete, and fresh everything downstream is. It has been engineering-led so far. You will be the first product manager for the Integration Ecosystem, working with a dedicated engineering team and reporting into the product organization. You own two things: the experience of setting up and managing integrations, and the behavior of the system underneath.

You will think from first principles about how an enterprises customer context should reach Enterpret, and build a cohesive ingestion layer on top of the integrations we already have.

What You Will Do
  • Run the fleet like a portfolio. Fifty integrations, each built on a platform whose APIs, data models, and conventions keep moving. You will prioritize by revenue impact and error frequency, put the hard calls in writing, and decide which platforms the ecosystem integrates with next.
  • Own the system-behavior metrics for ingestion: completeness, latency, and error rates. You will define them, instrument them, and be measured on them.
  • Own the integration setup and management experience end to end: connecting a source, scoping exactly what gets ingested (filters, backfill windows, previews), and managing it over time.
  • Define per-integration error taxonomies, decide which failures customers see and which page our team, and ship proactive notifications so customers hear about issues from us first.
  • Build agent-first setup: an agent inspects the customers source, proposes the right configuration, and the customer reviews and confirms. You decide where a form still earns its place.
What It Takes
  • Direct product ownership of integrations, connectors, data ingestion, or API products on technical B2B surfaces. You have carried them through real platform change, like API deprecations, auth migrations, and breaking version upgrades.
  • Fluency in how platform APIs actually behave - auth flows, webhooks, rate limits, pagination, deprecation cycles - enough to hold your own in trade-off debates with engineers.
  • You have defined reliability and experience metrics where none existed, instrumented them, and moved them.
  • Comfort operating AI-first. Our default is that not using AI for a task is the choice that needs explaining.
What Success Looks Like

In 3 months: You own the problem inventory for the integration ecosystem, prioritized by revenue and error frequency. The highest-usage integration has a complete error taxonomy, and it is the template the rest of the fleet follows. Baselines exist for completeness, latency, and error rates.

In 6 months: Setup is self-serve for the majority of sources. Customers resolve the most common issues themselves, and notifications reach them before they notice a gap.

In 12 months: Every integration has a health standard and is measured against it. The fleet runs on a maintenance lifecycle with owned processes for API deprecations and source-platform changes. New integrations launch to the standard by default, and customers cite the setup experience as a reason they trust the product.

Why Enterpret
  • The problem: Fifty platforms that keep moving, and an ingestion layer every downstream agent depends on. It is a hard systems problem and an open product canvas, and you would be its first product manager.
  • Growth: Work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership at a Series-B company, with a dedicated engineering team on your surface.
  • Benefits: Competitive salary, equity, hybrid work, premium healthcare.
What We Value

At Enterpret, we operate with a deep sense of ownership. We play for the team and do what it takes to win together. We care personally for our teammates while pushing each other with honest, actionable feedback. Above all, we approach everything with humility and a drive to keep learning and getting better.

Equal Opportunities

We ensure that none of our employees or prospective employees receives less favourable treatment as a result of age, sex, disability, marital status, colour, race, religion or ethnic origin. Equally we aim to ensure that no such employee is disadvantaged by terms and conditions of employment which cannot be justified.

jobDescription:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate we re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Principal AI Security Specialist to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to Ron Burkett. As enterprises race to adopt generative AI, Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security. In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection to serve as a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 executives. As our premier technical authority, you will help customers confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure.

What you ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close

  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage

  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force

  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, remaining comfortable building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner, letting your passion for the mission fuel a strong bias for action while navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture by giving and receiving candor with clarity and respect.

  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external customers to anchor decisions in solving real-world problems.

  • You are driven by innovation, possessing a deep curiosity for how things work and an energy for solving complex technical challenges to accelerate secure transformation.

What We re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them

  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles

  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations

  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes

  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications

  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage

  • Scale & Enablement Focus: A history of creating high-impact field assets, technical workshops, and competitive positioning content that helps broader go-to-market teams win

This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Actions technical partner in India.
About EAII
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action s technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families. For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
About Evidence Action
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we re making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  • Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
  • Through Safe Water Now, we ve saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
  • Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.
.
The Role
Our Accelerator is the engine for new programs. It is a venture-style, stage-gated pipeline that finds the most promising health interventions and develops the strongest into programs ready to scale. Only about 2% of the interventions we evaluate make it through, and those that do have gone on to raise over $100 million. The New Program Development (NPD) team drives this work. We source and vet new ideas, dig into the evidence and cost-effectiveness, build partnerships with researchers, governments, and implementers, and test concepts in the field to turn the best ideas into real programs.
We are hiring a Principal Manager to lead the development of our next generation of health programs. You will own a set of early-stage interventions and drive each one from a research insight to a program that is proven, fundable, and ready to scale, or to a clear and well-reasoned decision to stop. You bring the rigor of an analyst who can interrogate evidence honestly and reason carefully under uncertainty. You also bring the drive of a builder who can source opportunities, cultivate partnerships, and turn ideas into programs that work in the real world. Together, those strengths let you find and build the interventions that deliver the most health impact for every dollar spent. You will join a close-knit team that puts evidence first, thinks big, acts urgently, and is willing to challenge convention to reach more people. You will report to the India Country Lead with a dotted technical line to the Accelerator Director.
Responsibilities
  • Own a portfolio of pipeline interventions, end to end. Drive several promising candidate programs through the Accelerators stage-gate process, and decide what advances, what gets reshaped, and what exits our pipeline.
  • Interrogate the evidence with honesty. Assess each interventions evidence base on the merits, including effect sizes and their quality, external validity, variability, negative and contradictory findings, and gaps.
  • Model impact and cost-effectiveness under uncertainty. Partner with the Cost-Effectiveness team to build and pressure-test CEAs, reasoning explicitly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty, and translating them into clear go/no-go implications.
  • Design and run decision-relevant learning in close collaboration with our MLE team. Scope and execute lean, rigorous field activities such as scoping, formative research, and pilots, to unblock decisions.
  • Build the case and align stakeholders. Craft compelling, evidence-grounded investment cases. Bring researchers, implementers, governments, and donors along, anticipate objections, unblock barriers, and create momentum.
  • Collaborate across Evidence Action. Work hand in hand with our Growth team to build necessary resourcing and funding, relevant Program teams who bring the implementation muscle, and the Country Teams who cultivate and manage the policy and government partnerships in the places we work.
  • Be Evidence Actions face with partners. Independently lead conversations with study authors, implementing organizations, government officials, and funders, and use those relationships to source new ideas and partnerships.
  • Strengthen the Accelerators methods, AI-enabled workflows, and quality bar, and mentor analysts and interns on the workstreams you lead.
Essential
  • You have a bachelors degree and 6 - 10 years of experience in quant social science, program management, international development, or global health in a cross-country setting.
  • You read primary research and study design critically, synthesize large and conflicting evidence bases, and form an honest view of what the evidence does and does not support.
  • You build or rigorously interpret cost-effectiveness, epidemiological, or statistical models, and reason clearly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty.
  • You design lean learning activities that target the uncertainty actually blocking a decision, and you deliver them on a timeline.
  • You move things forward amid uncertainty, building, prototyping, and unblocking rather than waiting for perfect information.
  • You build trust and align both internal teams and external partners (researchers, implementers, government, and donors) across cultures and sectors toward a shared path.
  • You make complex technical findings clear and decision-useful for non-technical audiences, in writing and live.
  • You manage several workstreams at once, sequence sharply, and make defensible calls about where to spend scarce time.
  • You have experience working in an international setting and working with diverse teams.
  • You look for the reasons your favorite idea might be wrong, and welcome the same scrutiny of your own work.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary
Come join our engineering team in a hands-on technical role at the heart of a new discipline: Harness Engineering. As AI coding agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). As a Lead Harness Engineer youll build and own the individual controls that make up that harness, working end-to-end from problem to production.
Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, deploy, and support components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on systems and leverage, not hand-writing application code.
  • Build feedforward guides - agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods - that help agents get it right the first time.
  • Build feedback sensors - custom linters, static analysis, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues before they reach human reviewers.
  • Run the steering loop - when an agent repeats a mistake, engineer a control so it cant happen again - and help keep repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) legible to agents, fighting drift.
  • Contribute to quality gating and release criteria, and to LLM testing that ensures AI-generated output meets quality and safety thresholds.
  • Help improve observability into agent work and track the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate.
  • Evaluate the stability, compatibility, scalability, interoperability, and performance of harness components.
  • Continually learn new techniques in agent-augmented engineering, and serve as a source of technical expertise and mentor to junior team members.
Requirements
  • Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or related disciplines, or relevant experience in software architecture, design, development, and testing.
  • Strong software engineering background; youve worked in large codebases and care about architecture, testing, and maintainability.
  • Comfortable building tooling across a modern stack - linters and static analysis, CI pipelines, containerized build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability - and familiar with agent instruction conventions such as Agents.md.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a feel for where they succeed and fail.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, fitness functions, and developer-platform work.
  • A systems mindset - youd rather fix the environment than fix one output - and the ability to encode "what good looks like" into mechanical, repeatable rules.
  • Judgement about when to reach for deterministic, computational controls (type checkers, linters, structural/architecture-fitness tests) versus inferential, LLM-based ones (AI code review, LLM-as-judge) - and an understanding of the cost, speed, and reliability trade-offs between them.
  • Clear communicator; able to articulate design with architects and discuss strategy and requirements with teams.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Come join our engineering team to build the discipline that lets AI coding agents do reliable work at scale. As agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). This is a hands-on management role: you will personally build harness components while leading and growing a team of harness engineers and governing the responsible use of AI across your team.

What You'll Contribute

  • Personally design, build, deploy, and support components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role; you will contribute code, not just direct it.
  • Build and maintain feedforward guides (agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods) and feedback sensors (custom linters, architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers) that help agents get it right the first time and catch issues before they reach human reviewers.
  • Drive adoption of AI coding agents and harness practices through hands-on enablement - pairing, office hours, and reference examples - measuring success by active usage, review time saved, and defect escape rate rather than by artifacts shipped.
  • Govern responsible AI usage within your team, ensuring engineers apply AI tools appropriately, ethically, and in line with company standards, compliance requirements, and defined quality and safety thresholds.
  • Own quality gating and release criteria for your teams work - defining authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided and the escalation rules for what must route to a human.
  • Run the steering loop - when agents repeat a class of mistake, ensure a control is engineered so it cant happen again - and keep repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) legible to agents, fighting drift continuously.
  • Track and act on the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate.
  • Coordinate day-to-day activities and direct team members; monitor performance, and provide coaching, counseling, and motivation to maximise contribution.
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to attract talent, set goals, and measure and reward performance.
  • Serve as a source of technical expertise, including guidance on the effective and responsible use of AI tools.

What Were Seeking

  • Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or related discipline, or relevant experience in software design, development, and testing.
  • Strong software engineering background in large, complex codebases, with genuine care for architecture, testing, and maintainability - you remain hands-on.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a well-developed feel for where they succeed and fail.
  • Experience building engineering tooling across a modern stack - linters and static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerized build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability - plus familiarity with agent instruction conventions such as AGENTS.md.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, fitness functions, and developer-platform work.
  • A systems mindset - youd rather fix the environment than fix one output - and the ability to encode what good looks like into mechanical, repeatable rules.
  • Judgement about when to reach for deterministic, computational controls (type checkers, linters, structural/architecture-fitness tests) versus inferential, LLM-based ones (AI code review, LLM-as-judge) - and an understanding of the cost, speed, and reliability trade-offs between them.
  • Strong people management experience with the proven ability to manage a high-performing team, including navigating the organisational change that AI adoption brings.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive AI adoption within a team while governing responsible use, managing associated risks, and maintaining compliance awareness.
  • Working knowledge of the security surface unique to autonomous agents - prompt injection, tool/permission scoping, sandboxed execution, and audit trails for agent actions - and how to design least-privilege guardrails around them.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code as they relate to managing modern engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate design, strategy, and standards across teams.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Senior Voice AI Engineer - Gurugram, India - Full-time.

We are looking for a Senior Voice AI Engineer to build and scale next-generation conversational Voice AI systems. You will work on real-time, low-latency voice pipelines involving Speech-to-Text (STT), Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), WebRTC, telephony, and streaming infrastructure.

You should have hands-on experience building production-grade Voice AI agents using frameworks like Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar real-time communication platforms. This role requires deep understanding of streaming architectures, WebSockets, voice quality optimization, interruption handling, and scalable backend systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build production-grade Voice AI applications.
  • Develop real-time streaming pipelines for voice conversations.
  • Integrate STT, LLM, and TTS providers into low-latency conversational systems.
  • Build robust WebSocket/WebRTC infrastructure for bi-directional audio streaming.
  • Implement interruption handling (barge-in), turn detection, and Voice Activity Detection (VAD).
  • Optimize latency across the complete voice pipeline.
  • Integrate telephony providers such as Twilio, SIP, or LiveKit Telephony.
  • Develop scalable backend services capable of supporting thousands of concurrent voice sessions.
  • Design session management, state management, and conversation memory.
  • Build monitoring, observability, and analytics for voice conversations.
  • Deploy and operate Voice AI infrastructure on Kubernetes and cloud platforms.

Required Skills

Voice AI

  • Strong understanding of conversational Voice AI systems
  • Experience building real-time AI voice assistants
  • Knowledge of latency optimization techniques
  • Understanding of conversational memory and dialogue management

Speech Technologies

  • Experience with OpenAI Realtime API, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Google Speech, Azure Speech, Amazon Transcribe, Cartesia, or PlayHT
  • Streaming STT and TTS
  • Voice cloning and adaptive speech
  • Speaker diarization
  • Custom vocabulary and pronunciation dictionaries

Real-Time Communication

  • Pipecat
  • LiveKit
  • WebRTC
  • RTP
  • SIP
  • WebSockets
  • Server-Sent Events (SSE)

Backend Development

  • Python (preferred), FastAPI, AsyncIO
  • WebSocket servers, gRPC, REST APIs
  • Event-driven architecture
  • Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ
  • PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse (good to have)

AI LLM

  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or open-source LLMs
  • Prompt engineering, tool calling, function calling
  • RAG, agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, conversation memory

Cloud Infrastructure

  • AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • NGINX
  • Load Balancers
  • Autoscaling
  • CI/CD

Preferred Experience

  • Built production Voice AI products
  • Experience with Pipecat in production
  • Experience with LiveKit Cloud or self-hosted LiveKit
  • Experience with Twilio Voice or SIP infrastructure
  • AI phone agents and call center automation
  • Noise suppression (Krisp, DeepFilterNet, RNNoise)
  • Experience supporting 1,000+ concurrent voice sessions
  • Multilingual Voice AI

Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • 6-8 years of software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years building real-time streaming systems.
  • 2+ years working on Voice AI or conversational AI products.
  • Strong system design and distributed systems experience.

Key Responsibilities:

1. System Topology Architecture

  • Chassis Rack Definition: Lead the structural, electrical, and logical design of the UALink switch chassis, defining high-speed backplane topologies, cabled scale-up fabrics, and multi-tier switch hierarchies.
  • Signal Power Integrity Collaboration: Partner with electrical and SI/PI engineering teams to define parameters for ultra-high-speed SerDes routing across PCBs, flyover cables, and optical components, minimizing bit error rates (BER).
  • Scale-Up Fabric Optimization: Architect rack-level and row-level topologies that optimize collective communication paths (e. g. , All-Reduce, All-to-All) for tens of thousands of interconnected GPUs.

2. Platform Management Software Infrastructure

  • Control Plane BMC Architecture: Architect the end-to-end system management plane. Define how Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs) monitor, configure, and provision the switch using OpenBMC, Redfish, and PLDM over MCTP.
  • Boot Initialization Flows: Establish platform-level boot sequencing, multi-rail power sequencing, and secure multi-node firmware update orchestration.
  • Platform Security Architecture: Define the hardware security lifecycle, including Platform Firmware Resiliency (NIST SP 800-193), secure enclave integration, and Component Attestation (SPDM).

3. Advanced RAS Infrastructure Integration

  • Platform-Level RAS: Architect system-level Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) strategies. Define how the platform isolates hardware faults, routes around failed links, handles hot-swapping of fans, power supplies, and switch blades without dropping the AI training cluster.
  • Thermal Power Orchestration: Establish dynamic power management and telemetry frameworks to balance the massive transient power draws of next-generation AI workloads against rack-level cooling limits. Qualifications

Education Experience:

  • Degree: Master s or Ph. D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 20+ years of architectural experience in high-performance server platforms, hyper-scale network switches, or data center infrastructure.

Technical Skill Set:

  • System-Level Interconnects: Expert knowledge of high-speed platform fabrics and standards (UALink, NVLink, OAM/UBB, PCIe Gen6/Gen7, CXL, or Ultra Ethernet).
  • Platform Management Standards: Deep expertise in industry-standard management architectures, including Redfish, IPMI, MCTP, SPDM, and OpenBMC.
  • Hardware-Software Interface: Thorough understanding of OS/VMM kernels, device drivers, and platform initialization frameworks (UEFI, ACPI).
  • Data Center Infrastructure: Comprehensive grasp of modern rack architectures (e. g. , OCP ORv3), liquid cooling management, and high-density 48V/54V power delivery.

Preferred Attributes (Ways to Stand Out):

  • Proven track record of delivering a high-volume, multi-million-gate switching or compute platform successfully into top-tier hyper-scale cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, Meta).
  • Active committee leadership or direct specification contributions within the UALink Consortium, Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC), or Open Compute Project (OCP).
  • Experience architecting systems designed for ultra-high-density accelerator form factors (such as Nvidia Blackwell/Vera Rubin grids or AMD Instinct platforms).

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

We are looking for a UI/UX Design Manager to own the design function across Arcitech s product portfolio. This is the senior-most design seat in the organization. You will set design strategy across products, manage a team of 5-8 designers (including a Senior Design Lead who owns hands-on senior craft beneath you), run design across 7-8 concurrent projects, and be the design counterpart to product and engineering leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you are accountable for the shipped design of everything we ship.

This is a management role, not primarily a hands-on IC role. You are the strategist, the reviewer, and the leader of the function. Hands-on senior craft sits with the Design Lead beneath you; your job is to set direction, hold the bar, grow the team, and represent design at the leadership table. That said, at this stage of the company you will still design directly on the highest-impact work when required - particularly on strategic explorations, new-product launches, and cross-brand systems.

Prior experience in an IT / SaaS / product company is non-negotiable. Prior experience genuinely managing a design team of 5+ is non-negotiable. This is a role for someone who has already done this work before, not someone stepping up into it for the first time.

You will report directly to the CEO.

Responsibilities

Design Strategy Direction

  • Own the design vision and strategy across the SaaS portfolio.
  • Set priorities across 7-8 concurrent projects; make trade-offs when everything can t be built.
  • Represent design at the leadership table - product, engineering, and CEO reviews.
  • Own release-readiness and cross-product design decisions.

Team Management

  • Manage a team of 5-8 designers, including the Senior UI/UX Design Lead as your direct report.
  • Set clear expectations, run 1:1s and reviews, and own performance conversations end-to-end.
  • Grow the team s craft, career depth, and independence over time.
  • Own hiring for the design team - who joins, at what level, and how they ramp up.

Quality Bar Review

  • Define and hold the design quality bar across the whole team.
  • Review the Design Lead s work and the wider team s work; catch issues before ship.
  • Own design systems, brand-design consistency, and cross-product coherence.
  • Set the standard through your own review - not by out-designing the team.

Cross-Team Leadership

  • Partner with product management and engineering leadership on roadmap, scope, and trade-offs.
  • Represent design to the CEO and the wider org clearly - what s being built, why, and what s at risk.
  • Communicate design decisions to non-design stakeholders in business terms, not just design terms.
  • Coordinate with Brand / Marketing and the graphic-design function so brand and product visual languages stay aligned.

Hands-On Design (Selective)

  • Personally own strategic design work on the highest-impact / most-critical launches.
  • Design directly on cross-brand systems, new-product launches, and executive-visibility work.
  • Delegate day-to-day craft work to the Lead and the team - stay in strategy and review mode by default.

Required Skills

  • Experience: 6+ years in UI/UX design, with at least 3 years in a design-management role
  • Team management (must-have, non-negotiable): proven experience managing a design team of 5+ - real people-management with 1:1s, reviews, hiring, and performance calls; not just informal mentoring
  • IT / technology company background (must-have, non-negotiable): prior experience designing for and inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company
  • UI depth (must-have): senior-level UI craft - visual design systems, interaction patterns, component libraries, responsive design
  • UX depth (must-have): senior-level UX craft - research, flows, information architecture, usability, and design decisions grounded in user reality
  • Design strategy (must-have): genuine experience setting design direction across multiple products or product lines
  • Multi-project (must-have): proven ability to run design across 7-8 concurrent projects without dropping quality
  • Figma: advanced Figma - components, variants, Auto-Layout, plugins, libraries
  • AI-tools fluency: current, hands-on with AI design tools; adopted in real work, not just tried
  • Communication: clear, senior communicator; can represent design to the CEO and cross-functional leadership
  • Portfolio: senior-level portfolio required; must include team-led work and design-strategy examples, not just personal craft

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience building or scaling a design function from small to mid-size.
  • Experience designing for AI / ML / non-deterministic product surfaces.
  • Exposure to design ops - systems, documentation, and workflow tooling.
  • Experience working across multiple brands / product lines within one company.
  • Formal design education or equivalent professional depth.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has genuinely managed a design team of 5+, and can point to what specifically improved under their leadership.
  • Has worked inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company - not as an agency contractor - for a meaningful part of their career.
  • Is strong across both UI and UX - not stronger on one at the expense of the other.
  • Can balance strategy, review, team management, and selective hands-on work.
  • Communicates well with the CEO and leadership; represents design as a business function, not a purely creative one.
  • Runs a design function with process and craft, not chaos and heroics.

Portfolio Requirement

A senior-level portfolio is mandatory. We want to see two things clearly: (1) your own personal design work at senior IC level, and (2) work led through a team - what your team shipped, what your role was, and what changed under your leadership. Applications with only personal-craft portfolios and no team-led work will not clear the preliminary round.

Hiring Process

Our process is designed to assess design strategy, real management ability, and communication:

  • Preliminary portfolio review - a senior portfolio with team-led work is required to move forward.
  • HR conversation - initial screen for fit, background, and communication.
  • Design strategy conversation - with senior leadership on design direction, decisions, and philosophy.
  • Practical design exercise - a short, role-relevant strategy / review task; you walk us through your thinking.
  • Panel discussion - with product, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders on collaboration and leadership.
  • Final round with the CEO - a conversation on leadership, design ownership, and how you d run the function.

Why Join Arcitech AI

  • Own the design function at a fast-growing AI-native SaaS company.
  • Report directly to the CEO - close to the decisions, no layers of middle management.
  • Build the design function as the products and team scale.
  • Broad scope: product UI/UX, design systems, brand consistency, cross-brand coherence.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar Agentic AI frameworks.
  • Experience building AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
  • Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of multi-agent systems, workflow automation, and AI evaluation techniques.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations.
  • Experience building AI copilots, autonomous agents, deep research assistants, chatbots, workflow automation systems, or AI-powered SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with AI observability, monitoring, and evaluation platforms.
  • Knowledge of AWS cloud services, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working with Snowflake and modern data platforms.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevSecOps & Cloud Engineer with extensive experience in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise DevOps platforms, cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in GitHub Actions, Jenkins Shared Libraries, GitHub Enterprise migrations, Terraform, AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory or Nexus Repository Manager, and automation using Python and Shell scripting.

ad Role Description

At SSC, we are embarking on an exciting journey to reimagine software engineering through Artificial Intelligence, and were looking for an experienced AI Engineer to help lead that transformation.

What Youll Do

You will partner closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, QA teams, and technology leaders to identify opportunities where AI can drive meaningful productivity gains and improve software quality.

Using tools such as Claude Code and other AI-assisted development technologies, you will design and implement practical solutions that reduce manual effort, automate repetitive tasks, accelerate delivery, and enhance engineering outcomes.

You are a highly experienced software engineer with 10+ years of hands-on development experience in Java and Python and a passion for leveraging AI to solve real engineering challenges.

You will be a key creative contributor to AHEAD s Design CoE - delivering high-impact presentation design, visual storytelling, and consulting communication outputs that directly influence pursuit outcomes and client engagement quality. This is a hands-on design role that combines deep craft excellence with an understanding of consulting context and business narrative. You will work at the intersection of data, design, and technology, collaborating closely with consultants, researchers, analysts, and technologists to create best-in-class presentation, visualization, and analytics solutions.
Your work will directly shape how sharply AHEAD s ideas are expressed, how persuasively its stories land with CXO audiences, and how consistently the firm projects a consulting-grade visual standard across every client engagement.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design CoE Build-Out Team Leadership
  • Actively contribute to the smooth operation of the Design CoE - following intake workflows, briefing processes, quality review standards, and turnaround benchmarks; suggest improvements to processes as experience grows.
  • Collaborate closely with fellow Visual Communication Specialists and Presentation Analysts; model a design culture grounded in creative excellence, delivery discipline, and continuous improvement; support onboarding of junior team members when needed.
  • Participate in structured onboarding and training programs; take ownership of personal skill development across design craft, consulting communication, and emerging tools - and share learnings informally with peers.
  • Manage personal workload effectively across concurrent consulting engagements and research publications; flag capacity or prioritization conflicts proactively to the Team Lead.
  • Consistently meet quality and turnaround benchmarks; actively seek feedback from the Team Lead and stakeholders to raise the bar on every deliverable.
Narrative Excellence Strategic Design Partnership
  • Take primary ownership of complex, high-stakes design work - strategic proposals, executive communications, pursuit decks, and CxO/board-level presentations - delivering polished outputs with minimal iteration cycles.
  • Apply narrative excellence across consulting outputs: refining storylines, sharpening executive messaging, enhancing proposal storytelling, and translating insights into compelling slide sequences.
  • Transform unstructured inputs - scribbled notes, whiteboard captures, fragmented ideas, raw data, and oral briefs - into cohesive, structured, and visually compelling consulting narratives.
  • Collaborate with consulting and sales teams to develop differentiated win themes and visual pursuit strategies that strengthen proposal quality and CXO resonance.
  • Engage consulting stakeholders with recommendations on visual and narrative approach; build a reputation as a thoughtful creative collaborator who understands business context, not just design craft.
  • Translate analytical outputs into compelling visual stories and interactive experiences that make data and insight accessible and persuasive for client audiences.
  • Design interactive visualizations, exploratory data tools, and storytelling interfaces that elevate the quality and impact of AHEAD s consulting outputs.
Consulting Presentation Proposal Design
  • Execute end-to-end design of high-impact consulting presentations, executive proposals, and client-facing materials - from creative brief and storyboard through to polished, delivery-ready output.
  • Ensure all presentation materials comply with AHEAD s brand guidelines, maintain visual consistency, and project a consulting-grade professional standard across every client engagement.
  • Conduct self-review and peer review of design output before delivery; apply zero-defect, brand-compliant standards and incorporate creative feedback constructively to continuously improve output quality.
  • Handle the design intake and briefing process for assigned requests - ensuring accurate scope capture, clear expectation-setting on timelines, and proactive communication with requestors throughout delivery.
Visual Innovation Design IP Development
  • Actively contribute to the CoE s design IP initiatives - building reusable templates, visual frameworks, and self-service assets that scale design quality across AHEAD s consulting organization.
  • Contribute to and maintain AHEAD s visual asset library: standardized presentation templates, brand-compliant design systems, reusable frameworks, consulting-grade iconography, infographic libraries, and presentation accelerators.
  • Adopt and champion AI-powered design and productivity tools within your own workflow; contribute to building a high-velocity, human-in-the-loop design practice that delivers speed, quality, and brand governance.
  • Identify and implement design productivity improvements - automation shortcuts, reusable components, smarter iteration approaches - that meaningfully reduce rework and speed up content refinement cycles.
  • Stay current with best-in-class visual communication practices at leading consulting and advisory firms; bring forward relevant design innovations and ideas to strengthen AHEAD s creative edge.
Brand Stewardship Standards
  • Apply and uphold AHEAD s visual design language across all consulting outputs: presentation templates, color systems, typography standards, iconography libraries, chart styles, and data visualization frameworks.
  • Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of design standards, self-service playbooks, and consulting communication frameworks that enable consultants to produce brand-compliant, quality output independently.
  • Uphold consistency and quality of AHEAD s visual identity across all consulting, research, and thought leadership outputs - proposals, client presentations, research publications, CxO Guides, and webinar materials.
QUALIFICATIONS EXPERIENCE:
Essential
  • 6-9 years of progressive experience in presentation design, visual communication, or consulting design, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver high-quality design outputs in a consulting, advisory, or professional services environment.
  • Expert-level PowerPoint proficiency - master-slide management, bespoke layout design, complex data visualization, advanced charting, animation, and end-to-end deck construction from scratch to consulting-grade finish.
  • Strong working proficiency in design tools for infographics, custom visual frameworks, icons, and publication-quality design assets.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-powered presentation, design automation, and productivity tools used in a professional services or consulting environment.
  • Proven ability to translate unstructured inputs - notes, whiteboards, raw data, oral briefs - into polished, executive-ready consulting narratives and presentation materials.
  • Familiarity with design standards, brand systems, and template libraries; ability to apply and maintain them consistently across a range of consulting output types.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating consulting-grade presentation design - proposals, executive decks, research publications, and data-rich visual storytelling - produced to a high professional standard.
  • Creative excellence - sets a high aesthetic and storytelling bar for personal output; consistently delivers design work that elevates the quality of consulting materials and earns the trust of stakeholders.
  • Strategic communicator - understands the business context behind every brief and translates consulting intent into visual narratives that persuade, not merely present.
  • Builders mindset - comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete briefs; brings a structured, solutions-oriented approach to every engagement and thrives in a fast-moving, high-expectation environment.
  • Innovation-oriented - actively explores new design tools, AI capabilities, and automation opportunities; eager to evolve personal workflows and contribute to the CoE s technological and creative edge.
Preferred
  • Bachelors or master s degree in engineering, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, or a related creative discipline.
  • Prior experience in a consulting firm in a Visual Graphics, Business Presentation Specialist, or senior design contributor role.
  • Experience building or managing AI-augmented design workflows, including prompt-based design generation, document-to-presentation conversion, or design automation pipelines.
  • Proficiency with consulting-grade data visualization and charting tools, and the ability to translate analytical outputs into polished, presentation-quality visual formats.
Why AHEAD:
Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

title: Supply Chain Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.

To succeed in this role, you must have multidisciplinary skill set - proven experience in project management and SC planning, knowledge of planning systems (SAP APO/IBP, OM Partners or similar), SAP architecture (underlying tables, transactions) and strong technical and analytical skills.

In this creative role you will have unique opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders in the global organization working on various improvement initiatives, development of analytical tools, optimization models or supply chain simulations and you need to feel comfortable in each stage of this process (design, develop and deploy) to thrive and succeed.

You are self-starter with hands-on approach and continues improvement mindset working on your own initiative under moderate supervision. You know how to source and use data together with statistical methods and technology to improve processes. It is important you have theoretical knowledge but more important you understand how to use it in practice to add value.

Your nearest assignments will focus on portfolio segmentation, product life cycle management, development of replenishment strategies and inventory optimization within distribution network. All contributing to development of planning tool supporting decision making process for planning teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Supply Chain Management or APICS CPIM certification and 5-7+ years experience in Global Supply Chain and Inventory Management essential (multi-site, multi-region),
  • Degree or certification in Data Science desirable,
  • Formal Project Management and problem-solving training desirable, e.g., Six Sigma, Lean.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to select and work with appropriate analytical tools and software (Excel, PBI, relevant libraries in R and Python or SQL) and build ETL pipelines,
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Codex, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, troubleshooting, and creation of analytical tools while applying appropriate validation and governance,
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, data quality, business relevance, bias, and operational feasibility before applying them to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or decision-support processes,
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and visualize findings,
  • Demonstrated ability to wrangle, cleanse and model data from various sources (SAP, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .parquet, .rds, data lake etc.),
  • Proficient in Excel and Power BI (Power Query/M, DAX, relational database model, data visualization); Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is a plus,
  • Knowledge of SQL and R/Python highly desirable,
  • Experience working with data warehouse/data lake desirable (experience with Snowflake a plus),
  • Knowledge of Statistics and Machine Learning or strong willingness to quickly develop in this area.

Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and to prioritise actions for maximum impact.

Ability to develop and deploy short-term tools and reporting capabilities (with quantified accuracy and precision) essential.

Solid written and verbal communication skills, experience in a matrix environment desirable.

title: Success Architect - Marketing Cloud
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The MC Success Architect is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) within our Marketing Cloud product portfolio. We are looking for a passionate technical expert who has significant experience in delivering Marketing Cloud solutions to large enterprise organizations. Success Architects (SAs) are some of our most senior technical experts who provide proactive and reactive Architecture as well as Product Technical expertise. SAs deliver advisory engagements to help maximize customer success and adoption, as well as minimize attrition risk. They partner with key stakeholders at our largest, most complex customers to share their technical thought leadership and inspire the next generation of Digital Marketing Teams. This is an Individual contributor (IC) role.

Responsibilities

  • Be a trusted Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert for the broader Success Architect organization
  • Engage with our Signature and Strategic customers to evaluate and recommend optimization strategies for technical architecture, DevOps, performance, and solution design specific to Marketing Cloud
  • Translate complex technical concepts for audiences ranging from Technical, Business to Executive Stakeholders
  • Identify and evaluate capability gaps for standard product capability or identify creative solutions through customization
  • Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI
  • Develop and run playbooks aligned with our Success Architect engagement catalog, tailored to the unique needs and opportunities of Marketing Cloud customers
  • Build strong relationships with both internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals and growth

Impact of the Role

As a Marketing Cloud Success Architect, you will have a significant impact on our customers success and the growth of our organization. Your expertise and guidance will directly influence the technical architecture, performance optimization, and solution design strategies for our strategic customers, ensuring their success in leveraging Marketing Clouds powerful capabilities. By driving customer satisfaction and delivering exceptional value, you will contribute to the overall growth and reputation of Salesforce as a leader in the industry.

Collaboration and Teamwork

Collaboration is at the core of our success, and as a Marketing Cloud Success Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with diverse teams of professionals. You will collaborate with customers, colleagues, and partners to evaluate technical architecture, optimize performance, and design effective solutions. By fostering strong relationships and working collaboratively, you will contribute to the collective success of our teams and the achievement of our goals.

Basic Requirements

  • 10+ years proven experience in enterprise consulting, including implementing enterprise software solutions in the Marketing/MarTech space
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement (Email/Mobile) AND one of: Marketing Cloud Personalization OR Marketing Cloud Intelligence OR Marketing Cloud Account Engagement OR similar product
  • Deep understanding of data modeling, integration architectures, and data governance best practices.
  • Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Engagement scripting languages AmpScript, SSJS, GTL, WSProxy
  • Experience with system architecture design and integration patterns
  • Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Engagement Security capabilities and best practices
  • Excellent communication skills, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams from Developer to Executive
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging marketing, data-related and AI technologies
  • Proactive and self-starting attitude with the ability to manage tasks independently while collaborating remotely with customers and colleagues
  • Values the importance of Data Ethics and Privacy by ensuring that customer solutions adhere to relevant regulations and best practices in data security and privacy

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience implementing Salesforce Clouds, Multi-cloud scenarios - Sales, Service, Industries, Marketing or Commerce
  • Salesforce certifications
  • Familiarity with Salesforce s technical architecture: APIs, Standard and Custom Objects, APEX
  • Familiar with Marketing / Personalization platforms
  • Familiar with AI concepts
  • Knowledge of Data Management principles and experience with Customer Data Platforms or Data Lakes
  • Understanding of development tools including SLDS, XML, HTML, SQL, Javascript, JSON, and CSS
  • Other business level language skills e.g. Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, French etc

This role focuses on evaluating, implementing, and supporting EDA tools and design flows, while driving efficiency and innovation in engineering design processes. You will act as a key consultant to designers, helping improve workflows and align solutions across teams.

What You Will Do

  • Evaluate the EDA tool landscape and identify solutions aligned with the design roadmap across business groups.

  • Act as an EDA consultant, supporting stakeholders in defining and meeting their technical and roadmap requirements.

  • Provide regional (APAC) support for EDA tools, including development, project setup, deployment, and maintenance.

  • Develop Python-based applications to support design flows, tool integration, and standalone solutions by using vibe coding (AI)

  • Create and implement EDA interface scripts to build efficient and scalable design flows.

  • Identify and implement alternative EDA tools that offer improved quality, cost efficiency, or better Time to Market.

  • Provide technical support for models, DRCs, PDKs, TCAD, PCMs, and TOs, and quickly acquire new domain knowledge when required.

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in EDA tools, semiconductor design environment, or related engineering domains

  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with scripting languages such as Perl, Ruby, or TCL.

  • Understanding of semiconductor design processes and design flows.

  • Knowledge or affinity with TCAD, PDKs, and device modeling.

  • Experience in data processing and analysis.

  • Open-minded, curious, and eager to explore new technologies and EDA innovations.

  • Self-driven with an entrepreneurial mindset, able to identify challenges and proactively implement solutions.

jobDescription:
About Exotel

Exotel is the emerging market s leading AI-powered Customer Engagement Platform, enabling enterprises to engage customers seamlessly across Voice, Messaging, Video, Contact Centre and Conversational AI. Trusted by over 6,000 businesses across 60+ countries-including Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, HDFC Bank and Zomato-Exotel powers more than 50 million customer interactions every day.

As enterprises increasingly adopt AI-first customer engagement solutions, Exotel is at the forefront of delivering highly scalable, secure and enterprise-grade deployments across Contact Centre, CPaaS and Conversational AI.

Location: Bangalore or Gurgaon

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise implementations across Exotel s Customer Engagement portfolio. You will operate as the single-threaded owner for customer deployments, driving projects from kickoff through production go-live, hypercare and operational handover.

This is not a traditional project management role. You will be responsible for ensuring successful delivery of technically complex, integration-heavy implementations while maintaining governance across timelines, scope, risks, commercial milestones and customer expectations.

Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams-including Sales, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success and Finance-you will ensure every deployment is delivered on time, within scope and to the highest quality standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline with technical aptitude, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven ability to drive execution across multiple enterprise projects simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities Program Project Governance
  • Own the complete project lifecycle for multiple concurrent enterprise implementations from project initiation through production handover.
  • Build and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, RAID logs, dependency trackers and governance dashboards.
  • Define and enforce stage gates and entry/exit criteria across Kickoff, Solution Design, Development, UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare and Handover.
  • Drive regular governance reviews and provide accurate project health updates to customer and executive stakeholders.

End-to-End Delivery Execution
  • Lead enterprise implementations across Contact Centre, Voice, Conversational AI and customer engagement solutions.
  • Drive execution against committed timelines while balancing scope, quality and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate implementation activities across internal teams and external customer stakeholders to ensure timely project delivery.
  • Ensure all commercial, technical and operational milestones are achieved before project closure.
Customer Stakeholder Management
  • Act as the primary customer-facing delivery lead throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and manage communication across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Lead project governance meetings, steering committees, technical workshops and executive status reviews.
  • Communicate risks, dependencies and delivery updates with clarity and confidence.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Engineering and Product teams to translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Customer Success, Support and Finance to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Build solution documentation, Low-Level Designs (LLDs), implementation plans and Scope of Work (SOW) documents.
  • Drive alignment across teams to resolve blockers and accelerate project delivery.

Technical Delivery Enterprise Readiness
  • Coordinate complex enterprise integrations involving REST APIs, Webhooks, CRM platforms (Salesforce, Zendesk, Freshdesk), authentication systems, databases and third-party applications.
  • Manage enterprise deployment requirements including maintenance windows, change management processes and production readiness.
  • Coordinate customer Information Security reviews, compliance questionnaires, architecture reviews and deployment approvals.
  • Ensure customer environments are fully prepared for successful production deployments.

Risk, Scope Escalation Management
  • Proactively identify project risks, technical challenges and execution bottlenecks before they impact delivery.
  • Manage project scope through structured change management and prevent uncontrolled scope creep.
  • Drive timely resolution of customer and internal escalations through effective stakeholder management.
  • Maintain clear visibility into dependencies and ensure mitigation plans are actively tracked.

UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare Handover
  • Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, execution and customer sign-offs.
  • Coordinate production readiness assessments and Go-Live activities.
  • Lead post-production hypercare until solution stabilisation.
  • Ensure seamless transition to Customer Success and Support teams with complete operational documentation.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 6-8 years of experience in Technical Project Management, Program Management or Enterprise Delivery.
  • Proven experience delivering customer-facing enterprise software implementations in SaaS, CPaaS, CCaaS, Telecom or Cloud technology environments.
  • Strong track record of managing multiple concurrent enterprise deployments.

Technical Knowledge

  • Good understanding of enterprise software implementations involving APIs, REST integrations, Webhooks and cloud-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals and SIP-based telephony is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Voice infrastructure, RTP streams, codecs and enterprise communication platforms is a plus.
  • Exposure to enterprise Information Security processes, SOC 2, architecture reviews and data privacy standards is desirable.

Project Management

  • Strong experience managing project plans, RAID logs, dependency tracking and governance frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Salesforce or similar project management tools.
  • Ability to execute projects using Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methodologies depending on customer requirements.

Leadership Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-paced and cross-functional environments.
  • High ownership, accountability and bias for execution.

With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

This person will report to Manoj Selvarajan.
