  • Serve as the technical expert for ServiceNow ITOM capabilities including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, Certificate Management, and CMDB integration.
  • Configure, tune, and troubleshoot ServiceNow Discovery including MID Server configuration, credential management, patterns, probes and sensors, and discovery error resolution.
  • Maintain CMDB integrity through identification and reconciliation rules, data normalization, relationship mapping, and alignment with CMDB governance and ITIL best practices.
  • Discover and manage cloud resources in GCP including cloud-native services, dynamic infrastructure, and integration of cloud assets into the ServiceNow CMDB.
  • Design and implement automation using ServiceNow workflows, Flow Designer, APIs, and integrations with monitoring and infrastructure tools.
  • Perform systems performance analysis and root cause analysis of production incidents, including participation in 24/7 coverage as needed.
  • Complete hands-on development within the ServiceNow platform including but not limited to: client scripts, business rules, ui actions, ui policies, data policies, workflow, flow designer, integration hub spokes, script includes, catalog items, portal widgets, ui pages, event and alert rules.
  • Perform code review of peer development changes to ensure compliance with the Sabre ServiceNow Development standards and vendor s best practices.
  • Lead upgrade / patch skip remediation ensuring compliance with the Sabre ServiceNow Development standards and vendor s best practices.
  • Take ownership of high level / complex business requirements and works them to completion.
  • Understand business user stories / requirements to provide the technical design and solution for product enhancements / new features.
  • Deliver product enhancements, new features, and defect fixes on time and error free
  • Provide updated documentation of all product work including but not limited to, design documentation, technical operations / support documentation, and release notes.
  • Support existing and build new interfaces and have a good understanding of available integrations with 3rd party tools.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor/master s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7-8 years of experience implementing and administering ServiceNow ITOM capabilities including Discovery, Service Mapping and CMDB integration.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure components including servers, networks, cloud platforms, containers, and applications.
  • Strong understanding of network architecture, SOA, object-oriented analysis and design, and application development methodologies.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills including teamwork, facilitation, and negotiation.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture, modules, and functionalities.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Scripts, UI Actions, UI Pages, Script Includes, Access Control Lists, complex workflows and Solution migration to higher environment.
  • Experience in developing ServiceNow integrations using APIs, web services, and data

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Deep ServiceNow ITOM expert who can independently lead discovery architecture and CMDB governance initiatives.
  • Strong communicator who can bridge the gap between complex technical solutions and non-technical business stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker who can develop long-term roadmaps while staying engaged at the operational level.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively with technical teams, business users, and vendor partners.
  • Brings technical depth, professionalism, and accountability to every engagement.

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer based in New Delhi to support technical capture and pre-sales engagement for the X-BAT and V-BAT aircraft platforms in India. This role will serve as the in-country technical lead for Business Development, bridging Indian MoD operational requirements with Shield AI s product roadmap. The ideal candidate has prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM) in roles spanning engineering, technical sales, program management, or advanced capture, with exposure to tactical jet aircraft, CCA/ACA concepts, or Group 3/4/5 UAS programs. This individual will focus on shaping opportunities within the Indian market, supporting Go To Market of tactical aircraft, crafting proposal documentation, and providing technical expertise. This individual will also cross-train in Shield AI s other products to support integrated solution discussions.
What youll do:
  • Lead X-BAT and V-BAT technical capture efforts for Indian opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with Shield AI s product roadmap.
  • Capture efforts will focus on Aircraft, but will require familiarity with the entire Shield AI Product suite.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, including customer engagements, pre-sales technical support, proposal contributions, and solution development.

  • Proven ability to translate technical concepts into compelling narratives for senior stakeholders.
  • Bachelor s degree in engineering, applied science, or related technical discipline.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

  • Experience supporting international defense sales or industrial partnerships.
  • Familiarity with offset strategies and Make-in-India requirements.
  • Background in autonomy, AI-driven systems, or networked ISR.
  • Experience contributing to early-phase design or conceptual aircraft programs.
  • Prior military service experience (Indian or allied forces).
  • Advanced degree in engineering, aerospace, systems engineering, or business.
  • 5+ years of experience in an presales/solutions engineering role 3+ years of experience working in a startup environment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of specific MOD operational scenarios and systems.

Job Summary

This is a pivotal role for SmartBears India operations, combining hands-on HRBP partnership with company-wide accountability for statutory compliance. As HRBP to your assigned function, youll partner with senior business leaders to align People Culture strategies with business priorities, coach leaders on talent, performance, and organizational effectiveness, and drive strategic people initiatives that build high-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams. Youll also serve as Indias statutory compliance expert, owning alignment with Indian labor law across all India-based SmartBear employees including those outside your HRBP client group, regardless of function or reporting line, in partnership with our Director of Global People Operations.

About the Role:

  • Partner with business leaders to align People Culture strategies with organizational goals and translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
  • Coach and advise managers on performance management, employee development, organizational design, compensation, and employee relations.
  • Analyze employee engagement survey results and develop action plans with leaders.
  • Develop and implement talent retention strategies that enhance employee experience.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, influencing leaders through data, business insight, and People Culture expertise.
  • Collaborate across the People Culture organization to deliver consistent, scalable, and impactful people programs.
  • Partner with global People Culture teams to adapt enterprise-wide programs to local legal and cultural context.
  • The successful candidate will work from our Bengaluru, India office in hybrid model.

India Statutory Compliance (all India employees):

  • Own compliance with Indian labor law - including the Industrial Relations Code, Shops Establishments Act, and related regulations - for every India-based employee, regardless of which function or HRBP they are otherwise supported by, serving as SmartBears go-to expert on India employment regulation.
  • Partner with the Director of Global People Operations, Legal, and other HRBPs to maintain visibility into employment actions (hiring, compensation changes, terminations) across functions, so compliance risk is caught even outside your direct client group.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for India regulatory questions raised by other HRBPs or business leaders.

We are looking for you if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in a senior People Partner or HR Business Partner role, ideally within a high-growth technology environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to develop and implement strategic People Culture initiatives.
  • Strong expertise in performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Experience analyzing employee engagement data and translating insights into measurable action plans.
  • Excellent communication, coaching, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • A passion for building inclusive, high-performing teams and creating exceptional employee experiences.
  • Strong working knowledge of Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements is required, given this roles company-wide compliance ownership.
  • Experience working as part of a global, distributed People Culture team is a plus.
  • A background in people operations - including HR systems, processes, and policy administration - is a plus.

Job Title : Senior Product Manager

Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

  • Strong opinions about driver / operator UX - has shipped for low-context, high-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).

  • Jira-as-source-of-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.

  • Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision-by-tradeoff over decision-by-framework.

Nice to have

  • Logistics / last-mile / supply-chain domain background.

  • Multi-tenant SaaS scoping experience (whats product vs. whats tenant config).

  • Comfort with domain-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity-first specs


What We Offer

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

- Maintain accurate records, documentation and audit trails in accordance with regulatory requirements, and internal policies.

descriptionFromApi:
Skills: #Golang #DistributedSystems #Microservices #Fintech #CloudNative #SoftwareArchitecture #EngineeringLeadership

Are You The One

You are a seasoned technologist with a product mindset - equally comfortable designing a distributed ledger service or simplifying a compliance-driven API for partner integration. You understand that technical excellence is not just about code - it's about systems that scale safely, teams that deliver predictably, and decisions that align with long-term product goals.

You will be a technical north star for multiple product and platform teams - defining architecture, aligning technical strategies with business outcomes, and mentoring technical leads and senior engineers to raise the engineering bar.

You Will Contribute To

Domain and Architectural Leadership

  • Deeply understand core financial domains (card issuance, payments orchestration, remittance, ledger systems) and translate this knowledge into resilient bounded contexts, canonical data models, and API standards.
  • Define and own the long-term backend architecture roadmap, ensuring coherence across microservices and shared infrastructure.
  • Champion clean architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles, owning complex cross-domain decisions (e.g., transaction reconciliation, settlement workflows).
  • Serve as the architectural authority in design reviews, incident postmortems, and roadmap discussions.

Engineering Excellence and Quality

  • Lead the engineering excellence charter, establishing organization-wide guidelines for code quality, testing, CI/CD, and security hygiene.
  • Define and continuously track key engineering KPIs (e.g., Service SLAs, MTTR, Deployment Frequency) to quantify and improve outcomes.
  • Mentor technical leads and senior engineers, raising the overall engineering bar and enabling Generative AI-assisted engineering workflows responsibly.

Hands-on Technical Contribution

  • Architect, prototype, and profile Go-based distributed services for high-throughput, low-latency financial flows.
  • Apply expert knowledge of Go's concurrency, synchronization, and runtime tuning to design performant and scalable services.
  • Lead postmortems, fault-injection sessions, and conduct deep-dive performance tuning using tools like pprof.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Influence

  • Partner closely with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Business teams, translating functional requirements into resilient technical designs.
  • Represent engineering trade-offs in executive forums and lead major cross-functional initiatives (e.g., multi-region rollout, PCI-DSS compliance).
  • Maintain technical debt registers and remediation plans, acting as the technical conscience to balance delivery pace with operational integrity, security, and auditability.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of backend engineering experience, with at least 5 years in Go in high-scale, distributed systems.
  • Proven experience architecting and scaling financial systems (payments orchestration, card processing, or ledgering).
  • Expert understanding of Go concurrency, synchronization, and runtime tuning.
  • Strong grounding in relational data design (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and event-driven patterns.
  • Practical knowledge of security, encryption, and compliance standards (PCI-DSS, MAS, ISO 27001) in a regulated fintech environment.
  • Experienced in observability and SRE practices (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana) and capacity planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction at scale, including articulating complex issues to all organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with IaC, Kubernetes, service mesh, and API gateways.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Copilot, CodeWhisperer) is a plus.

The role spans the entire AI lifecycle use-case identification, model and system design, production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement.

Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows using leading LLM platforms.

Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to enable AI systems to securely leverage internal knowledge and data sources.

Develop and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step, decision-based business processes.

Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment, versioning, monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization.

Define, implement, and maintain evaluation metrics for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Leadership, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.

Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data privacy, reliability, and maintainability.

7 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with 3 to 4 years of hands-on work on production AI / LLM systems.

Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and maintainable code.

Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, FAISS, ChromaDb, or similar).

Practical experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Autogen, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel.

Prior experience building AI solutions in SaaS or enterprise-scale software environments.

Experience integrating with major LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.

Solid understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering (context window management), and output control techniques.

Experience deploying AI systems to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.

Working knowledge of LLMOps MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies.

Experience in implementing guardrails in AI Solutions along with Observability.



Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Exposure to multimodal AI systems, model fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Understanding of AI cost optimization, latency tuning, and performance benchmarking in production.

Experience with domains such as eCommerce, Retail, HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, etc



Language Documentation Expectations

All production AI code must be clearly documented, version-controlled, and supported by appropriate tests.

AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows must include design documentation and usage guidelines.

Each production AI system must have defined ownership, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.

Clear documentation of model limitations, assumptions, and fallback behaviours is mandatory.




What We Offer

High-visibility role with direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Opportunity to design and own enterprise-scale AI systems with real business impact.

Hybrid work arrangement, balancing flexibility with collaboration.

Job Description: Solution Architect - Agent Platform

This role will be responsible for partnering with client stakeholders at the board and executive levels to translate complex business challenges into production-ready autonomous agentic architectures. You will own the technical relationship during the discovery phase, blueprint the core reference architectures, and guide our internal engineering pods through successful implementation.


Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture & Technical Blueprinting

  • Design and document standardized, enterprise-grade Reference Architectures for multi-agent orchestration and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using the Claude Code or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
  • Blueprint end-to-end "Agentic Workflows," mapping out how multi-turn reasoning, persistent memory, and state management will behave in live environments.
  • Build reusable architecture scaffolds and integration patterns that allow developers to connect agents to core enterprise systems (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, ServiceNow, Salesforce and custom telemetry stacks).
  • Transition seamlessly from abstract whiteboard designs to concrete implementation by writing core foundational code, configuration scripts, or orchestration loops alongside the engineering team.
  • Act as the technical bridge between Softilitys delivery teams and Google Cloud's partner engineering group to unblock platform-level execution barriers.

2. Tactical Pre-Sales & Consultative Engagement

  • Act as the primary technical authority during high-touch, pre-sales discovery workshops to discover, define, and scope client use cases.
  • Conduct highly technical product demonstrations and deliver deep-dive sessions to client engineering teams, effectively neutralizing competitive technologies (e.g., OpenAI Assistants, AWS Bedrock).

3. Model Optimization & Workload Selection

  • Evaluate enterprise tasks to select the optimal model configuration, balancing computational efficiency and accuracy.
  • Define token budget management strategies and performance caching layers to ensure client systems scale effectively.
  • Design benchmarking metrics to continually evaluate agent precision, grounding scores, and execution latency.

4. Security, Compliance & Semantic Governance

  • Oversee absolute security compliance for all agent deployments, ensuring architectures adhere to Zero-Trust standards and strict data residency mandates.
  • Design and implement Semantic Governance Layers to enforce safety guidelines, prevent hallucinations, and automate PII masking before data reaches foundational model layers.

Required Technical Experience & Qualifications

  • Cloud Expertise (preferably GCP): Deep architectural knowledge of Google Cloud Vertex AI (Agent Platform), BigQuery, VPC Service Controls, and IAM security frameworks. Holding a Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification is highly preferred.
  • Agentic Frameworks & AI Tooling: Proven experience building production-level autonomous systems utilizing the Gemini ADK, LangChain, or comparable agentic libraries.
  • Backend Mastery: Exceptional proficiency in Python or Node.js, combined with deep familiarity with API design, enterprise webhooks, and asynchronous message queues.
  • Modern Integration Standards: Direct experience working with enterprise application API architectures (REST, gRPC) for platforms like Salesforce, ServiceNow, or large-scale Observability stacks.
  • System Observability: Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel), logging fabrics, and monitoring frameworks to track agent behavior in production environments.
  • Enterprise Software Delivery: Strong experience in modern DevOps methodologies, including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and automated CI/CD pipeline structures.
